Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

  • Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
  • Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

  • Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

  • Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

  • Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

  • Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
  • Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
  • The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

  • Contract type: full-time or part-time
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together.   • A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals

jobs.description:

At Tether, weâre not just building products, weâre pioneering a global financial revolution. Innovate with Tether

But thatâs just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.



Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels.Â We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:Â https://tether.recruitee.com/

jobs.title: Director Payment Integrity
jobs.description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. \n

  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.

Experience:

  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

About The Role

There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

What You'll Do

  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."

jobs.title: Test Engineer - QA Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:

Dann werde Teil von Nelta, einem wachsenden IT-Beratungshaus mit Fokus auf Qualitätssicherung, Automatisierung und moderne Softwarearchitekturen.

Wir bei Nelta bieten unseren Kunden ein erstklassiges Leistungsportfolio, bestehend aus innovativen Lösungen sowie integrierten und ganzheitlichen Services. Darüberhinaus agieren wir als strategischer IT Partner für diverse, internationale Projekte. Dabei legen wir ein großes Augenmerk auf unsere Unternehmenswerte – Vision, Verbindlichkeit, Fokus, Transparenz und Respekt – und gestalten danach unseren Alltag!

Aufgaben

Als Test Engineer / Consultant bist du in externen Kundenprojekten im Einsatz und verbindest fachliche Testkompetenz mit einem starken Consulting-Mindset.
Du arbeitest hands-on im Testing, analysierst komplexe Systemlandschaften und trittst beim Kunden souverän und lösungsorientiert auf.

Deine Aufgaben als Testautomation Engineer (w/m/d):

  • Einsatz als Test Engineer / Consultant in externen Kundenprojekten

  • Durchführung automatisierter und manueller Softwaretests auf unterschiedlichen Teststufen

  • Erstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Testfällen, Testszenarien und Testplänen

  • Testen von Schnittstellen und Integrationen in komplexen Systemlandschaften

  • Durchführung automatisierter API-Tests (z. B. REST, GraphQL, HTTP)

  • Analyse von Fehlerbildern in verteilten Systemen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Entwicklung, Testmanagement und angrenzenden Teams

  • Aktive Kommunikation von Testergebnissen, Risiken und Handlungsempfehlungen gegenüber Kunden

Unser Teck Stack
Je nach Projekt nutzen wir folgende Technologien: Selenium, Tosca, Ranorex, Confluence, JIRA, Postman, Silk Central Manager, HPALL, Java, JUnit, REST, Jenkins, Docker, Maven, AWS, Microservices, Cucumber, Gherkin.

Qualifikation

Was Du dafür schon mitbringst:

Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Software-Testing (ca. 2–3 Jahre oder mehr)

  • Erfahrung in manuellen und automatisierten Tests

  • Praxis in der Erstellung von Testfällen, Testplänen und idealerweise Testkonzepten

  • Erfahrung mit Testmanagement-Tools wie Xray, Zephyr, SAP Solution Manager oder vergleichbaren Tools

  • Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierungs-Frameworks wie
    Selenium, Cypress, Robot Framework, Playwright oder ähnlichen Technologien

  • Gute Kenntnisse im API-Testing (REST, GraphQL, HTTP)

  • Grundverständnis verteilter Systeme

  • Gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Programmiersprache (z. B. Java, Python oder C#)

  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten und sicheres Auftreten

  • Consulting-Mindset: Du kannst deine Arbeit, Testergebnisse und Empfehlungen verständlich und überzeugend vertreten

  • Keine Scheu vor direkter Kundenkommunikation (Abstimmungen, Workshops, Interviews mit Fach- und IT-Ansprechpartnern)

  • Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und proaktive Arbeitsweise

  • Bereitschaft, bei Bedarf im Hamburger Office zu arbeiten

  • Reisebereitschaft für externe Kundenprojekte

Nice-to-have:

  • Erfahrung im Banking- oder Finanzumfeld

  • Erfahrung in der fachlichen Unterstützung oder Einarbeitung von Teammitgliedern

  • Erste Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützten Ansätzen oder automatisierten Workflows
    (z. B. n8n, Zapier oder vergleichbare Tools)

  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Foundation Level

  • Interesse an neuen Technologien und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung

Benefits

Neben einer selbst bestimmten und agilen Arbeitsweise bieten wir Dir:

  • Eine attraktive Vergütung und Bonuszahlung bei Erreichung von individuellen Zielen.

  • 28 Urlaubstage zum Start mit jährlicher Staffelung sowie Möglichkeit für Workation.

  • Du gestaltest Deinen Workflow ganz flexibel und individuell, bist aber bereit Dich wichtigen Terminen und Meetings anzupassen.

  • Individuelle Rabatte durch Corporate Benefits.

  • Wellpass Mitgliedschaft mit über 5.140 Sport- und Wellnesseinrichtungen deutschlandweit.

  • Lohnoptimierungsbausteine ( Internetzuschuss, Kindergartenzuschuss, etc.) durch unseren Partner Finstein

  • Investition in Deine Zukunft durch Sprach- und Persönlichkeitstrainings.

  • Auswahl modernster Hardware (MacOS, Linux oder Windows).

  • Ein überdurchschnittlich familiäres und freundliches Arbeitsklima mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Individuelle Einarbeitung (vor Ort) mit eigenem Mentor.

  • Ein idyllisches Büro an der Hamburger Alster, damit Du auch in stressigen Phasen zur Ruhe kommen kannst.

Bei Nelta wird Kommunikation großgeschrieben und kreative Ideen und Lösungsvorschläge sind sehr willkommen und werden mehr als wertgeschätzt.

Wie wir Dich weiterentwickeln?
Wir legen großen Wert auf Weiterbildung unserer Mitarbeiter, d.h. konkret wir bieten Dir Freiraum für Weiterbildung und spendieren Dir Teilnahmen an Workshops, Konferenzen o.ä. Hauptsache Du hast Lust was zu lernen und sprichst mit uns darüber! Regelmäßige Weeklies mit Deinem Lead helfen Dir und uns dabei zu erkennen, wo und wie wir Dich individuell am besten unterstützen und fördern können. Abgerundet wird das Ganze mit internen Coachings und Trainings zu aktuellen aber auch Business relevanten Themen. Zudem stecken wir gerade aktiv in der zweiten Wachstumsphase und bieten jedem der sein Potenzial ausschöpfen will die Möglichkeit seine Zukunft und die von Nelta aktiv voranzutreiben. Bei uns wird jeder gefördert und keiner überhört!

Klingt gut soweit?
Dann freuen wir uns sehr darauf Dich kennenzulernen! Teil uns am besten gleich mit, wann Du starten könntest und wo Dein Gehaltswunsch liegt. Ein Anschreiben hingegen brauchst Du nicht. Wir tauschen uns mit Dir lieber persönlich bei einem virtuellen Kaffee oder einem Besuch vor Ort in unserer Bürovilla aus.
‍
Be Nelta. Be more.

jobs.title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)

McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé

  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;

  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;

  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;

  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. jobs.title: Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tools Development Intern
jobs.description:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

  • Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
  • Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
  • Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.


The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
  • Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
  • Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python.
  • Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
  • Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
  • Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.


What you need to be successful

  • Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python.
  • Good understanding of:
    • Fluid mechanics
    • Thermodynamics and heat transfer
    • Numerical methods and computational modelling
  • Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
  • Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
  • Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
  • Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
  • Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
  • Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Good technical communication and documentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and critical thinking.


Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required:

  • Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
  • Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
  • Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
  • Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
  • Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
  • Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
  • Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
  • Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
  • Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
  • Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.


Expected internship outcomes

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

  • A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
  • An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
  • Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.


Supervision and collaboration

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

Piomic Medical AG is an award-winning Zürich medtech company on a mission to change how chronic and acute wounds are treated. Our lead indication is diabetic foot ulcers, a condition with one of the highest mortality rates in healthcare. Our breakthrough COMS® therapy (Concurrent Optical and Magnetic Stimulation) is a non-invasive treatment that delivers physical stimulation to deep tissue for wound healing. What you bring

  • Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in industrial design, product design, mechanical/medical engineering or a related field
  • Hands-on skills in CAD and prototyping, including 3D printing
  • An independent, structured way of working and careful documentation
  • English, German is a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience with plastics, silicone or injection-molded parts
  • Basic electronics or embedded programming, for example microcontrollers or RFID/NFC
  • Interest in regulated products such as medical devices
  • You like to tinker and build things that work

What we offer

  • ownership from day one: your designs become working prototypes that go into testing
  • Hands-on impact on a breakthrough therapy for one of the deadliest conditions in healthcare
  • First-hand experience of how medical devices are developed under European and US regulatory requirements
  • A paid position with competitive pay
  • Hybrid work and a modern open workspace directly at the Zurich HB
  • Flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams

jobs.title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
jobs.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications.

Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives.

What We Can Offer 

This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts.

If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment.

You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI 

You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks.

What You Will Do 

  • Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay.

  • Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa.

  • Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC).

  • Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation.

  • Support EDI workstreams within global ERP initiatives and local rollouts across business units, maintaining consistency with global integration templates.

  • Monitor daily EDI transactions, prioritise critical issues and resolve integration or transmission failures to help prevent supply chain disruptions.

  • Analyse performance across EDI networks and clearing centres, identify recurring errors and bottlenecks, and coordinate configuration adjustments and testing with external providers.

  • Maintain standard messages and application interfaces in line with relevant industry standards and data compliance requirements.

  • Collaborate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external providers to deliver and support integrations involving both Infor and other applications.

What We Expect of You 

Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Strong familiarity with the document sequences supporting core supply chain processes such as Order to Cash (O2C) , Logistics and Source to Pay (S2P), including orders, invoices and shipping notices.

  • Extensive hands-on experience in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), B2B integration frameworks and complex data mapping environments.

  • Strong technical proficiency in EDI mapping tools, XML schemas and data transformation languages.

  • Good awareness of global B2B messaging standards, such as EDIFACT, and electronic communication protocols.

  • Proven ability to read and analyse Java code in Eclipse IDE to debug custom mapping extensions and data routing rules.

  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate business and trading partner requirements into clear mapping and interface specifications.

  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including root-cause analysis of data payload errors and transmission failures, with sound judgement in challenging situations.

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus.

Valuable Experience 

  • Practical knowledge of Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC), Infor ION Framework and Infor OS, including their integration with Infor M3 and the routing of EDI documents into core applications.

  • Familiarity with Mapping Manager and Business Document Mapper within the Infor integration environment.

  • Onboarding customers, suppliers and 3 PLs via EDI.

Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Germany. Please note that visa or work-permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

About Intersnack IT: 

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. Our goal is to provide a common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services, and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG. 

About Intersnack Group: 

Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. We are now present in more than 30 countries across Europe and beyond. We have 12 regional Management Units, 45 production sites, and a total workforce of approximately 15,000 people worldwide. For further company insights, please visit the following link: Intersnack Group Overview 

If you want to be part of our dynamic food industry success story, you’ll find all sorts of opportunities at Intersnack. Join our team, help us grow, and celebrate our successes together!

  • Du betreust deine Kundenbetriebe als externe Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit nach DGUV Vorschrift 2 und planst deine Einsätze selbst: Woche, Route und Schwerpunkte.

  • Du hältst Unterweisungen, die hängen bleiben, und dokumentierst so, dass deine Kunden ihre Fortschritte sehen und verstehen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ArbSchG, BetrSichV, ArbStättV/ASR und dem DGUV-Regelwerk, aus der Praxis und nicht nur aus dem Lehrbuch.

  • Erfahrung im Brandschutz ist ein Plus. Die Qualifikation zum Brandschutzbeauftragten kannst du im ersten Jahr auf unsere Kosten erwerben.

  • Du erklärst technische Risiken so, dass Lagerleiter und Geschäftsführerin gleichermaßen handeln und du bleibst freundlich, aber klar, wenn ein Mangel sicherheitskritisch ist.

Was du bekommst

  • Betriebliche Weiterbildung, die du dir aussuchst: BSB-Lehrgang, BG-Fortbildungen, Umwelt- oder Gefahrstoffqualifikation bekommst du von uns.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeit, Homeoffice, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Betriebsarzt, kostenloser Parkplatz, Mitarbeiter-Rabatte uvm.

So geht’s weiter

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Danach folgen ein kurzes Telefonat, ein Fachgespräch per Video mit jemandem, der den Job selbst macht, ein Kennenlernen vor Ort und ein halber Tag bei einem Kunden.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

jobs.title: Head of Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies and we work with SAP consultancies who use Qorelo in their own client projects.


The role

As Head of Operations, you make sure what we sell actually goes live, and that the company behind it runs without friction. Your job is to make our customers successful and to free up the founders, sales and engineering to do the work only they can do.

We are growing from a small founding team into a company that runs several enterprise rollouts at once, works with SAP consultancy partners, and is hiring across engineering, sales and product. That growth needs one person who owns how it all fits together.

You report directly to the founders and our diffrent department Heads. This is not an admin role. Half of it sits right next to the customer.

What you'll own

  • Customer delivery and onboarding. From signature to live. You run the rollout plan with our Forward Deployed Engineers and solution architects: kick-off, access and security onboarding, milestones, steering meetings. You make sure every customer reaches value on time, and you spot the risk before it becomes an escalation.

  • Commercial operations. Contracts, order forms, framework agreements, procurement and supplier onboarding at enterprise customers, invoicing and collections. You make the paper process predictable so deals close faster and cash comes in on time.

  • Partner operations. We work with SAP consultancies and system integrators who use Qorelo in their own client projects. You set up and run how that works in practice: agreements, enablement, joint delivery, reporting.

  • Finance and planning. Budget, burn and runway tracking, monthly reporting, board and investor material, together with our external tax advisor and accountants. You know the numbers and can explain them.

  • People operations. Hiring process, onboarding, contracts, payroll setup, equity administration, tools. Every new joiner is productive in their first week.

  • Systems and process. You decide what we build, what we buy and what we outsource, and you use AI to keep the team lean.

What you need

  • 4+ years in operations, delivery or customer-facing project roles, with at least 2 years at a B2B software startup or scale-up.

  • Hands-on experience running enterprise rollouts or implementations: you have taken software through enterprise IT, security, procurement and works council onboarding.

  • Commercial and financial fluency: you can read a contract, build a budget, track runway and explain the numbers to a board.

  • You build process only where it helps, and you are just as happy doing the work yourself as designing the system for it.

  • You use AI tools in your daily work and are curious about what else they can automate.

  • Business-fluent German and English. Most of our customers are in DACH.

You might be a fit if

  • You have worked in or around the SAP ecosystem, at a consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor, and know how a transformation programme runs.

  • You have been an early operations, chief of staff or COO hire at a startup and built the operating backbone from scratch.

  • You have worked with partners or resellers and know what it takes to make a channel deliver.

  • People call you when something has to get done and nobody owns it.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo is built. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior operations leaders in Berlin.

  • The scope. You build the operating backbone of a company selling to Fortune 500 and DAX 40 customers.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the founders.

  • 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg, and the flexibility to work where you are most effective. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your operations and delivery background with Louis, our CEO (60 min)

  3. Offer

How to apply

Send us your CV at ----- or apply on our careers page. No cover letter needed, but we would love two or three sentences on the messiest rollout or operational problem you took over, and how you fixed it.

Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.description:
Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

  • Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

  • Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

  • In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

  • Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

  • Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

  • Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software.

  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen.

  • Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract.

  • Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

  • Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen.

  • Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting.

  • Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager.

  • Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris.

jobs.description:
53acht steht für die Koordinaten der Region Bremen und Oldenburg. Wir sind von hier und mögen es offen und ehrlich. Wir wissen, wie unsere Auftraggeber ticken und welche spannenden Aufgaben es bei ihnen vor Ort zu erledigen gibt.

Für ein etabliertes Bremer Unternehmen, das sich schwerpunktmäßig mit der Verwaltung und Entwicklung eigener Immobilienbestände beschäftigt, suchen wir im Rahmen der Direktvermittlung zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n

IT-Systemadministrator:in (m/w/d)

Aufgaben

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der internen IT-Infrastruktur

  • Administration der bestehenden Server-, Netzwerk- und Systemlandschaft

  • Übernahme der Rolle als zentraler interner Ansprechpartner für IT-Themen

  • Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung mit dem externen IT-Dienstleister

  • Einrichtung und Betreuung von Arbeitsplätzen sowie der dazugehörigen Hard- und Software

  • Administration von Windows- und macOS-Umgebungen

  • Unterstützung der Anwender bei technischen Fragestellungen im First- und Second-Level-Support

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der eingesetzten Unternehmensanwendungen

  • Analyse und Behebung von Störungen im laufenden IT-Betrieb

  • Mitwirkung bei anstehenden Projekten zur Erneuerung und zum Ausbau der IT-Infrastruktur

  • Einführung und Integration neuer IT-Lösungen und Systemkomponenten

  • Mitwirkung bei der Digitalisierung und Optimierung interner Prozesse

Unser Kunde arbeitet aktuell eng mit einem externen IT-Dienstleister zusammen und möchte seine IT-Kompetenz künftig zusätzlich intern verstärken. Gesucht wird daher jemand, der die bestehende IT-Infrastruktur im laufenden Betrieb betreut, als interner Ansprechpartner Verantwortung übernimmt und die weitere Entwicklung der IT aktiv mitgestaltet.

In der kommenden Zeit stehen dabei auch größere Projekte zur Erneuerung und zum Ausbau der IT-Infrastruktur an, bei denen du deine Erfahrung einbringen und zunehmend Verantwortung übernehmen kannst.

Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration von IT-Systemen und ein sicherer Umgang mit Server- und Netzwerkinfrastrukturen

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Administration von Windows-Systemen, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit macOS

  • Erfahrung im Anwendersupport und Freude an der Lösung technischer Problemstellungen

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit ERP-, DMS- oder vergleichbaren Unternehmensanwendungen

  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie eine ausgeprägte Service- und Kommunikationsorientierung

Das bietet unser Kunde

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in einem etablierten Bremer Unternehmen

  • Vielseitiger IT-Aufgabenbereich mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung

  • Langfristige berufliche Perspektive

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen

  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld

jobs.title: Vestigingsmanager Onderwijs
jobs.description:
Wil jij de verantwoordelijkheid over jouw eigen vestiging, leidinggeven aan een team én dagelijks impact maken op de ontwikkeling van jongeren? Bij Lyceo combineer je ondernemerschap, management en onderwijs in één rol. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, volop vrijheid en de kans om zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de groei van leerlingen én jouw vestiging.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Vestigingsmanager

Als Vestigingsmanager ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw Lyceo-vestiging. Dankzij jouw inzet krijgen leerlingen de begeleiding die hen helpt effectiever te leren, meer zelfvertrouwen te ontwikkelen en betere resultaten te behalen. Je runt jouw eigen vestiging als een ondernemer binnen de organisatie. Daarbij stuur je een team van studentbegeleiders aan, onderhoud je contact met ouders en scholen en zorg je ervoor dat de vestiging kwalitatief én organisatorisch optimaal presteert. Je bent dagelijks zichtbaar aanwezig, signaleert kansen in de regio en bouwt aan duurzame samenwerkingen met scholen en ouders. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Juist die combinatie van management en persoonlijke begeleiding maakt deze rol zo afwisselend en betekenisvol.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • leidinggeven aan, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team studentbegeleiders;

  • voeren van intake-, evaluatie- en adviesgesprekken met leerlingen en ouders;

  • organiseren van roosters, administratie en plannen van aanpak;

  • opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met scholen en andere stakeholders in de regio;

  • actief onderdeel zijn van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en leerlingen ondersteunen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding;

  • realiseren van groei, kwaliteit en resultaat binnen jouw vestiging.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

• hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren;

• ondernemende instelling en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

• commercieel inzicht en oog voor groei en resultaat;

• sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden;

• we zoeken kandidaten op goede reisafstand van jouw vestiging. We hebben momenteel kansen in de volgende plaatsen: Hengelo, Utrecht, Laren en Delft.

Jouw werkgebied

Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Hengelo, Laren en Delft.

Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging.

Benefits

Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

• volledig door Lyceo betaalde pensioenbijdrage van 6%;

• variabele beloningsmogelijkheden gekoppeld aan resultaten en groei;

• een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week, net wat past bij jouw situatie, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

• vrij tijdens de schoolvakanties*;

• laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

• volledige ov-vergoeding of reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer;

• toegang tot de Lyceo Academie met diverse trainingen en opleidingen;

• persoonlijke begeleiding door een clustermanager en een eigen buddy;

• aantrekkelijke kortingen via Benefits At Work;

• regelmatige borrels, teamuitjes en een jaarlijks feest;

• betekenisvol werk, waarbij resultaat en impact hand in hand gaan.

*Naast de meivakantie en de laatste week van de zomervakantie ben je tijdens alle schoolvakanties vrij. Hiervoor wordt maandelijks 5,77% ingehouden ter compensatie van deze bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen, naast de 25 wettelijke vakantiedagen. Je bouwt vakantiegeld en pensioen op over je volledige bruto maandsalaris.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen.

Als marktleider binnen dit domein is Lyceo volop in beweging. De organisatie groeit hard en heeft duidelijke ambities voor de toekomst. Je komt terecht in een betrokken en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat, maar waar ook ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën.

De impact is groot: scholen beoordelen Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger. We zoeken continu naar de beste samenwerking tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs en doen er alles aan om ieder kind tot z’n recht te laten komen.
