jobs.title: Director of Solution Consulting
jobs.description:
Director of Solution Consulting (AI & Enterprise Workflow Solutions)

 

➡️ Have you led and developed high-performing Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering teams within enterprise SaaS, data or AI?

➡️ Do you have the technical depth to go beyond traditional pre-sales, with hands-on experience in AI, APIs, integrations and workflow automation?

➡️ Want to lead a global function at the forefront of AI-powered innovation, helping some of the world's leading organisations transform how they approach R&D, Intellectual Property and technology development?

If this sounds like your next move, we'd love to hear from you.

Role Summary:

Patsnap is seeking a commercially minded, technically capable leader to manage and develop our global Solutions Consulting team, supporting all products supporting Patsnap's portfolio across Intellectual Property, Life Sciences, Materials Science and Engineering.

As we expand our AI capabilities, our approach to Solutions Consulting is evolving. Beyond traditional product demonstrations and technical evaluations, we're increasingly helping customers integrate Patsnap's intelligence, AI agents and data directly into their existing systems and business workflows.

You'll lead an established global team of Solutions Consultants, strengthening its technical capabilities and expanding the function through the introduction of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs). This includes defining how the team approaches technical discovery, solution development and customer engagement, ensuring we're equipped to support increasingly complex enterprise requirements.

This role offers the opportunity to have a genuine impact on how we operate, how we support our customers and how we bring our next generation of AI capabilities to market.

We're looking for someone who brings substantial experience leading customer-facing technical teams, alongside the technical depth to challenge, guide and contribute to solution development. You'll be responsible for building a function that not only supports commercial growth, but plays an increasingly important role in how customers adopt and integrate Patsnap's technology into their operations.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid position based in our Farringdon office, with a requirement to work on-site at least one day per week, on Wednesdays.

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO technology company transforming how organisations use Intellectual Property and Research & Development intelligence to drive innovation.

Our AI-powered platform connects patent intelligence, scientific research, Life Sciences data and market insights, helping organisations make more informed decisions, accelerate R&D and bring new innovations to market.

Trusted by over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the world's leading innovators, we've raised $300 million in Series E funding, reaching a valuation of over $1 billion.

As we continue to evolve into an AI-native business, we're enabling customers to integrate our proprietary data, AI agents and intelligence directly into their existing technology and business processes.

With offices in Singapore, London, Toronto and Shanghai, alongside remote teams across the US, we're an international business with ambitious plans for continued growth. Our culture is high-performing but low ego, with a strong emphasis on collaboration, ownership and developing people.

What You'll Be Doing:

Global Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach and develop the global Solutions Consulting team, setting clear expectations for performance, customer impact and commercial contribution.

  • Recruit and integrate FDEs, combining consulting expertise, domain knowledge and practical technical delivery within one team.

  • Assess capability gaps and implement development plans covering AI workflows, MCPs, APIs, data handling, prototyping and solution design.

  • Establish practical standards for technical proficiency and ensure learning translates into demonstrated customer-facing capability.

  • Prioritise team resources across regions, verticals and commercial opportunities.

  • Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Customer Engagement & Commercial Partnership

  • Partner closely with Sales, Account Management and Customer Success to support new business, expansion and customer adoption.

  • Lead discovery sessions that uncover customer priorities, workflows, technical requirements and desired business outcomes.

  • Oversee and participate in demonstrations, workshops, technical evaluations and enterprise solution discussions.

  • Translate complex product and data capabilities into clear customer value and compelling commercial propositions.

  • Establish clear scope, success criteria and timelines for proofs of concept (PoCs), aligning technical work with qualified commercial opportunities.

  • Build trusted relationships with business leaders, domain practitioners and technical stakeholders.

AI, MCP & Data Solution Delivery

  • Lead by example in configuring and demonstrating practical solutions using Patsnap’s products, AI agents, MCPs, APIs and data.

  • Help customers incorporate Patsnap capabilities into their own AI environments and business processes.

  • Guide Solutions Consultants and FDEs in building rapid prototypes, testing workflows and validating customer value.

  • Ensure evaluations consider output quality, source traceability, data permissions, integration requirements and usage costs.

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering to progress successful prototypes into supported solutions, with Engineering owning production architecture, security and platform development.

Product Collaboration & Scalable Solutions

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering and subject matter experts to translate customer needs into product improvements and repeatable solutions.

  • Create a clear process for sharing field feedback and progressing promising customer prototypes into product development.

  • Turn successful engagements into reusable Skills, connectors, workflow templates, demonstrations and implementation guidance.

  • Ensure the team can support the full portfolio, drawing on domain specialists where deeper expertise is required.

  • Contribute to commercial enablement through use cases, discovery frameworks, demo narratives and evidence of customer outcomes.

  • Identify recurring customer needs that create opportunities for differentiated data offerings, integrations and AI workflows.


What We'd Love From You:

We're looking for an experienced Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering leader who has successfully developed customer-facing technical teams and understands how to build a function that contributes directly to enterprise commercial success. you'll bring the technical depth to engage meaningfully in solution design and AI development, alongside the leadership experience to build capability at scale.

Required Experience

  • Proven leadership experience: 5+ years leading Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering or comparable customer-facing technical teams within enterprise SaaS, data or AI.

  • Commercial impact: Proven experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles, influencing technical buying decisions and connecting technical solutions to measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Technical credibility: Practical experience with APIs, data integrations, AI tools and workflow automation, with the ability to build, adapt or critically assess technical prototypes and demonstrations.

  • AI and agentic workflows: A working understanding of AI agents, MCP and how LLM-powered applications connect with external systems, tools and data.

  • Team development: Experience recruiting, coaching and developing technical talent, including improving the technical capabilities of an established team.

  • Enterprise customer engagement: Strong discovery, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to engage senior business leaders and technical decision-makers.

  • Global and cross-functional leadership: Experience working across international teams and partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Product and Engineering.

  • Strategic and commercial judgement: The ability to assess opportunity value, prioritise resources and balance technical delivery with wider commercial objectives.

Even Better If You Have:

  • Experience introducing Forward Deployed Engineering capabilities or evolving a traditional pre-sales function towards more advanced technical solution delivery.

  • Exposure to Intellectual Property, Life Sciences, R&D, Materials Science or innovation intelligence.

  • Experience using Python, JavaScript or low-code tools for prototyping, data manipulation and workflow automation.

  • Knowledge of enterprise AI adoption, including retrieval, AI agent evaluation and data governance.

  • Experience turning customer-specific technical solutions into reusable assets, integrations or scalable product capabilities.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

jobs.title: Hands-on Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

  • Prototype fabrication, assembly & testing: You stay closely involved after the CAD work is complete. You support prototype fabrication, assembly and testing, investigate issues and incorporate the learning back into the design.

  • Technical leadership & design reviews: You act as a senior technical reference for the team, supporting the Design Engineering line manager with design reviews, engineering standards and approval of critical designs. You support the extended team with technical judgement on complex mechanical design decisions, help maintain strong engineering practices and share your experience through everyday collaboration, mentoring and constructive challenge.

  • Cross-functional engineering collaboration: You work with manufacturing, testing, process engineering, procurement, suppliers and other engineering disciplines to ensure mechanical designs work as part of the complete product. You integrate external design resources where needed.

At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.

  • Produce and maintain critical engineering artefacts including specifications, electrical schematics, interface control documents (ICDs), analysis reports, verification plans, and design review material. 

  • Apply systems engineering and MBSE principles to ensure traceability between requirements, architectures, analyses, verification activities, and flight-test outcomes. 

  • Identify and mitigate system-level risks associated with power availability, thermal loading, EMC performance, reliability, safety, integration complexity, and operational resilience. 

  • Act as a technical authority across electrical power systems, collaborating closely with avionics, controls, software, thermal, mechanical, EMC, and systems engineering teams to deliver robust vehicle capability. 


Who you are 

  • An experienced Power Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex electrical power, energy storage, avionics, aerospace, defence, automotive, space, or other mission-critical systems. 

  • Strong background in electrical system architecture, requirements management, systems integration, verification, and validation across the full engineering lifecycle. 

  • Deep understanding of electrical power generation, power conversion, battery systems, energy storage, power distribution, protection systems, and power electronics. 

  • Experienced in electrical analysis including load-flow studies, transient response, fault analysis, protection coordination, power quality, thermal performance, and reliability assessments. 

  • Comfortable designing and integrating high-performance electrical power systems within highly constrained environments where weight, volume, efficiency, and thermal management are critical. 

  • Familiar with systems engineering and MBSE approaches, using structured methods to manage complexity, interfaces, traceability, and technical risk. 

  • Experienced supporting major design reviews, qualification campaigns, integration programmes, and the transition from concept through detailed design and verification. 

  • Technically credible across multiple engineering disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction. 

  • Comfortable operating in ambitious, fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly and engineering decisions have significant programme impact. 

  • Motivated by solving difficult engineering problems and delivering technologies that strengthen European sovereign defence capability. 


What we offer 
 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 


Security and Eligibility Requirement 
 

Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for German Security Clearance.

Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

Typically an EPM accompanies 1 to 3 teams in their delivery, ranging from technical projects (e.g. scalability and performance, SRE) to more functional ones (e.g. bringing automations to our product).

For instance, suggest evolutions to roles and responsibilities, better organize knowledge management, or work on large-scale projects related to quality management and production stability.
 
Federate: You contribute to the general well-being of the team, upon opportunity and based on affinity, for example as an organizer of regular instances (all-hands meetings, newsletters…), hackathons, team building activities, and any other idea related to the promotion of Pigment culture internally and externally. As a team, we have a mission statement and a roadmap that we maintain over time. We are open to different styles and we rotate responsibilities and projects on a regular basis between us. If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture, and our organization, we invite you to explore our Tech Blog!

Technical project/product management, engineering management, quality engineering, and production-related roles are typically the kind of roles where such an experience is demonstrated, but we are open to a diversity of backgrounds.

Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai.
 
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE
 
En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus.
 
Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits.
 
 
VOS MISSIONS
 
·       Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en accompagnant l’équipe dans l’atteinte des objectifs du point de vente.

PROFIL

You will lead the entire customer delivery lifecycle, from identifying high-value business opportunities and designing multi-agent architectures to deploying production-ready systems. Combining strong software engineering expertise, applied AI knowledge, and event-driven architecture experience, you will transform AI concepts into secure, scalable, and reliable enterprise applications. You will work closely with customer engineering teams, business stakeholders, and internal product specialists to accelerate the adoption of intelligent automation. Your responsibilities will also include establishing best practices for agent development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance while mentoring other technical professionals. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation within an international, customer-focused, and technically ambitious environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Own the technical success of enterprise customers' agentic AI initiatives, managing the complete delivery lifecycle from initial discovery and solution design through development, production deployment, ongoing operations, and advisory services.

  • Design and implement sophisticated multi-agent architectures, including agent decomposition, orchestration, task delegation, tool integration, memory management, state handling, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Develop, review, and troubleshoot production-quality software using Go or Python, building agents, plugins, tools, and integrations that meet enterprise requirements.
  • Deploy and operate agentic AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, data sources, and legacy systems through MCP servers, A2A protocols, REST APIs, and event-driven messaging architectures.
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, knowledge bases, embeddings, and real-time event context strategies to improve agent accuracy and access to relevant information.
  • Apply the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) throughout solution delivery, covering requirements gathering, architecture design, evaluation pipelines, testing, version control, release management, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Establish robust observability, security controls, governance frameworks, and responsible AI practices for agentic systems, including tracing, quality evaluation, cost and latency monitoring, access control, and auditability.
  • Advise customers on large language model selection and optimization across providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS Bedrock, and Azure AI Foundry, considering prompt engineering, token consumption, costs, and model performance trade-offs.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts, AI-related risks, and architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Travel when required to support customer engagements, including occasional international travel.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in professional services, technology consulting, systems integration, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise application development.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying LLM-based applications and agentic AI solutions, including at least one solution successfully taken into production.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management, with practical experience applying a structured Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC).
  • Strong programming proficiency in Go or Python, with Go considered a significant advantage.
  • Practical experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems, including task delegation, orchestration, coordination, and autonomous decision-making.
  • Familiarity with agent development frameworks such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or comparable technologies.

  • Solid understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and context management techniques.
  • Experience implementing evaluation frameworks, observability solutions, and security guardrails for enterprise LLM applications.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience deploying distributed applications on cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Understanding of enterprise security and identity management practices relevant to AI systems, including OAuth 2.0, role-based access control (RBAC), secrets management, and data privacy.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintech-Unternehmen Frankreichs. Derzeit beschleunigen wir unsere Expansion nach Deutschland 🇩🇪

In sechs Jahren haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro an Finanzierung eingeworben, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem bekannten Venture-Capital-Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal investiert hat.

🤝 Wir genießen das Vertrauen von Tausenden Kundinnen und Kunden sowie Steuerkanzleien und erhalten hervorragende Bewertungen.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1,3 Millionen kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich.

Strategy & Operations bei Pennylane

Teil des Strategy-&-Operations-Teams bei Pennylane zu sein bedeutet, die operativen Realitäten genau zu verstehen. Während wir unsere deutsche Gesellschaft aufbauen, entwickeln und implementieren wir effiziente und skalierbare Lösungen, die Pennylane dabei unterstützen, seine ambitionierten Expansionsziele zu erreichen.

Deine Rolle wird entscheidend dazu beitragen, lokale Abläufe von Grund auf zu strukturieren, bestehende Prozesse zu skalieren und unser Operating Model an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes anzupassen.

Um diesen Markteintritt erfolgreich zu gestalten, arbeiten unsere Strategy-&-Operations-Teams täglich eng mit den Business-Teams, beispielsweise in Sales und Customer Success, den Tech-Teams, darunter Entwicklerinnen, Entwickler und Product Managerinnen und Product Manager, sowie den Data-Teams, darunter Data Scientists und Data Analysts, zusammen.

Dein Ziel

Du steigerst die Produktivität unserer Teams deutlich, indem du die Nutzung unserer Tools optimierst, Prozesse vereinfachst und operative Strukturen aufbaust, die den Aufbau und die Expansion unserer deutschen Gesellschaft unterstützen.

Dein täglicher Beitrag

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bist die zentrale Ansprechperson und treibst Veränderungen in den Business-Teams für den deutschen Markt voran.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den operativen Verantwortlichen aus den Bereichen Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support und Account Management zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Transformation vorantreiben und den Status quo hinterfragen: Du beobachtest, hörst zu, stellst bestehende Strukturen infrage und schlägst kontinuierlich Optimierungen vor, um den Zeitaufwand für manuelle administrative Aufgaben und die Datensuche zu reduzieren. Du schaffst die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum in Deutschland, strukturierst die Abläufe einer neuen Gesellschaft und dokumentierst alle Prozessänderungen.

  • Operative Verbesserungen umsetzen: Du setzt lösungsorientierte Initiativen durch die Einführung neuer Informationssysteme, die Anpassung bestehender Anwendungen oder organisatorische Veränderungen um. Dabei leitest du Projekte und nutzt das Know-how verschiedener Teams, darunter Data, Sales und Finance. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört außerdem, eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen, Zeitpläne einzuhalten und die relevanten KPIs der Implementierung zu überwachen.

  • Prozesse skalieren und lokalisieren: Du passt globale operative Strukturen an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes an und stellst gleichzeitig sicher, dass sie mit den zentralen Pennylane-Standards übereinstimmen.

  • Benchmarking und Innovation: Du beobachtest andere Abteilungen, trittst einen Schritt vom Tagesgeschäft zurück, führst Benchmarks durch und sammelst Erkenntnisse, um unsere operativen Strategien weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Teams befähigen und die Akzeptanz neuer Lösungen fördern: Du etablierst klare Kommunikationswege und praxisnahe Unterstützung für die deutschen Teams, damit sie sich reibungslos in neue Methoden und Arbeitsweisen einfinden, beispielsweise durch optimierte Tools, Schulungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen.   • Die Schnittstelle zwischen Operations und Unternehmensstrategie bilden: Du entwickelst ein übergreifendes Verständnis für die Herausforderungen des Unternehmens, um frühzeitig zu erkennen, wie sie sich auf unsere lokalen Aktivitäten in Deutschland auswirken. Mithilfe datenbasierter Erkenntnisse schaffst du mehr Transparenz über unsere operativen Abläufe.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine ambitionierte Persönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfahrung in der organisatorischen Transformation, der Steigerung der Produktivität, im Projektmanagement und im Aufbau operativer Strukturen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

Deine Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du verfügst über mindestens vier Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Business-Transformation und in der Steigerung operativer Effizienz durch die Implementierung von Systemen und Tools.

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit Markteintritten, dem Aufbau neuer Gesellschaften oder der Skalierung operativer Strukturen gesammelt oder bringst eine starke Motivation für diese Themen mit.

  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung im End-to-End-Projektmanagement. Du kannst Probleme schnell erfassen, zügig Lösungen umsetzen und iterativ arbeiten, ohne auf Perfektion zu warten.

  • Du kannst zwischen detaillierten Einzelheiten und einer übergeordneten strategischen Perspektive wechseln.

  • Du besitzt sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zusammenfassen.

  • Erfahrung mit SaaS-Geschäftsmodellen sowie Tools wie Salesforce und Intercom ist von Vorteil.

Was wir dir bieten

Wir arbeiten zügig. Der gesamte Bewerbungsprozess dauert in der Regel zwischen 15 und 25 Tagen.

Wir haben versucht, dir so viele Informationen wie möglich über die Ziele, Aufgaben und das Umfeld dieser Position zu geben. Jetzt bist du an der Reihe: Zeig uns, ob du glaubst, dass diese Position dir die Möglichkeit bietet,

jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Join Perk as a key member of our Customer Care team for our Spend platform. Where you will play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional customer experiences. As a representative of Perk, you’ll help resolve a variety of inquiries, provide insightful support, and ensure every interaction contributes to our commitment to excellence.

Perk Spend is Perk’s spend-management platform, bringing employee expenses, supplier invoices and corporate card payments together in one place so finance teams can manage company spending alongside our Travel product

In this role, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams and learn our ever-evolving product suite, helping customers navigate their needs while upholding our values of transparency, empathy, and efficiency.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer queries via email and phone in a timely and knowledgeable manner

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues while providing accurate information and following up as needed

  • Document interactions and escalate complex cases to the appropriate teams

  • Ownership of incoming requests from customers, including the creation of tickets for the internal organization

  • Ownership for tracking-to-resolution of recorded incidents or bugs

  • Answering and handling customer inquiries for our customers for our German speaking clients.

  • Internally, you’re the first point of contact for knowledge on the operational use of our software

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in FinTech, financial or accounting software companies is a must have

  • Experience providing technical support and troubleshooting technical issues directly with customers

  • A background working in finance and or accounting is a strong plus

  • Operational experience with a high volume of external customer inquiries and internal clarifications from the team

  • Experience working towards KPIs across multiply channels such as phone, email and chat

  • Ability to handle a variety of tasks at a high frequency

  • Structured and detail oriented approach to work

  • Fluency in English and German, additional languages are a plus

 
 

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish and Catalan lessons

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support


Interview Process

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Assessment + Team manager interview - In person in our Berlin office
Final interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the role

Litmus is hiring an Account Executive to own and grow new business with industrial manufacturers across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Iceland and Finland.

Litmus is an industrial DataOps and edge AI platform. We help manufacturers connect, normalize and use data from their plants, from shop-floor assets up to the cloud. Our customers use Litmus to break down OT data silos and scale analytics and AI across sites.

You will be the face of Litmus in the Nordics. You will build pipeline, run complex enterprise sales cycles end to end, and work closely with our pre-sales team, hyperscaler partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks) and system integrators. You will report in to the VP EMEA.

What you will do

• Own a Nordic territory and its revenue target, from prospecting to signed contract and expansion.

• Build and qualify pipeline through outbound, events, partners and inbound leads.

• Run discovery with plant, operations, OT and IT stakeholders up to C-level, and map their business case for change.

• Lead structured, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including proofs of value, commercial proposals and negotiation.

• Work hand in hand with pre-sales on demos, solution design and technical validation.

• Co-sell with hyperscalers and system integrators, and develop partner-sourced opportunities in your region.

• Keep forecasts and opportunity data accurate in Salesforce.

• Expand existing accounts from first site to multi-site and global rollouts.

• Bring market feedback back to product, marketing and leadership.

What you bring

Segment experience (required)

• 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven record of meeting or beating quota.

• Direct sales experience in industrial software: IIoT, industrial DataOps, data historians, MES, SCADA, edge computing or manufacturing analytics.

• A solid grasp of the OT/IT landscape in manufacturing, and of how plant data flows from machines to the cloud.

• Experience selling into manufacturing, process industries, energy or similar industrial sectors.

Nordic market knowledge (required)

• An established network among industrial manufacturers in the Nordics.

• A working understanding of Nordic buying culture, decision-making and procurement.

• Familiarity with the regional partner and system integrator landscape.

• Fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, Danish or Finnish).

How you work

• Comfortable running long, complex deals with many stakeholders.

• Disciplined in qualification and forecasting (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or similar).

• Self-driven and at ease building a territory in a growing team.

Nice to have

• Experience selling alongside Microsoft, AWS, Google or Databricks.

• Track record of displacing incumbent industrial software, such as historians or legacy integration tools.

• Experience in an early-stage or scale-up team in a new region.

Travel and location

• Up to 40% travel within the Nordics and to EMEA team and partner events.

• Based in the Nordics, ideally near Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen or Helsinki.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

About the Enterprise segment

jobs.title: Design Ops
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⚡ The design and research community at Alan

Alan’s Design & Research (D&R) community is the group of designers and researchers behind everything our members see and use. Our goal is simple: build the most member-centric health experience there is, with high standards of craft and a real understanding of the people we design for.

We are growing fast, and AI is changing what is possible in the way we work. We are looking for someone who loves tooling, ops and AI to help us move faster without lowering the bar on quality.

This is a builder role where design, operations and AI meet. You will scope where AI and automation can help us build faster, scale better and catch quality issues earlier, then turn the best ideas into tools the community actually uses. Along the way, you will help us improve our rituals and best practices, and share what we learn inside and outside Alan. You are not a designer or a researcher yourself: you are the enabler that allows the community to go faster and perform better as our member base grows.

🤝 Your missions

You will help D&R work smarter and keep quality high as we grow, in close collaboration with the community, its lead, and the engineering, Product Ops and platform teams we work with. You will help shape our community strategy on AI and tooling, then build and run what comes out of it.

  • Explore: Test new AI tools and automations, find the ones that really save time or improve quality, and share the best with the community. Work with our internal AI tooling teams to bring what’s cutting edge to design and research.

  • Build: Create skills, agents and automated checks that make design and research work more efficient, reliable and of higher quality.

  • Run the tooling: Maintain and upgrade the tools the community relies on, and be our point of contact with Alan’s platform and agentic teams.

  • Improve how we work: Bring in better practices and rituals, push our existing rituals to the next level and help us show what we learn and achieve, inside and outside Alan.

  • Own your roadmap: Identify opportunities, prioritize solutions, set clear goals, track adoption and quality, and adjust as you go.

🚀 You are a good fit if...

You are an ops-minded builder with around 4 years of experience in ops or enablement roles: design ops, tooling, automation, analytics, program management or something close. Design and research interests you, but what drives you is helping teams work better with tools, automation and better rituals.

What you bring

  • Hands-on experience automating work. You have replaced repetitive tasks with automations, internal tools or AI workflows (no-code, low-code or AI tools), at work or on your own projects, and you can tell us what you built and who used it.

  • Familiarity with AI tools. You have built or tested skills, agents or automations, and you care that they are reliable, not just impressive in a demo.

  • Comfort working with engineers. You can build things yourself, you know when to ask for production-grade work, and you speak their language.

  • Experience supporting a team or community, for example through onboarding, rituals, events or internal communications.

  • Strong English communication, to collaborate with our international team. French is a plus.

Nice to have

  • Experience in or alongside a design or research team.

  • Familiarity with Figma and design systems.

Qualities we look for

  • Builder and strategic mindset: you make progress with incomplete information, choose the simplest approach that works, and ship.

  • Rigour: you set a baseline and a target, and improve with each iteration.

  • Systems thinking: you see how people, processes, tools and data fit together.

  • Judgment: you frame ambiguous problems, prioritise, and know what to drop.

  • Clear communication: you keep people updated and explain your choices.

🌍 Where you can be based

Location: Based in (or within commuting distance of) one of our hubs (Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona), with the ability to work onsite twice per week. We prefer you have the right to work here.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Web
Senior Technical Project Manager
Senior Scrum master
jobs.description:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen,  wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

  • Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

  • Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

  • Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

  • Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

  • Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.


  • Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

  • Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

  • PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering.

  • Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

  • Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

  • Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

 
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

jobs.title: Marketing & Communicatie Stage
jobs.description:
MARKETING & COMMUNICATIE STAGE
jan 2027

Afdeling: KEUNE Nederland & Vlaanderen, Marketing

Ben jij altijd online en op de hoogte van de laatste haartrends? Vind je het leuk om te ondersteunen bij de organisatie en uitvoering van Events en PR? Als Marketing & Communicatie Stagiair(e) ondersteun je het Marketing team in hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden zoals het uitrollen van nieuwe campagnes, organiseren van Events en PR-activiteiten. Daarnaast heb je ook je eigen verantwoordelijkheden en zal je volledig meedraaien in het marketing team. Een greep uit je werkzaamheden als Marketing Stagiair bij ons:

Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen.


MISSION

  • Je helpt bij het creëren van nieuw POS-materiaal, zoals banners, flyers, etc;

  • Je stuurt maandelijks de nieuwsbrief uit naar al onze klanten;

  • Je ondersteunt het team bij de organisatie en uitvoering van events en PR;

  • Je houdt nieuwe (haar)trends nauw in de gaten om inspiratie op te doen voor Social Media en Events.


YOU

  • Jij volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau;

  • Je draait volledig mee in het team en doet praktijkervaring op. (Geen afstudeerstage!);

  • Beheersing van Nederlands is een must (!). Engels is een pré;

  • Jij begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn;

  • Jij gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief;

  • Jij bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen;

  • Jij hebt ervaring met de programma’s Canva en Adobe;

  • Jij bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt);

  • Je bent 40 uur per week beschikbaar.


OUR OFFER

  • Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie;

  • Een duurzaamheidsbewuste werkgever;

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving;

  • Collega's die investeren in jouw talent;

  • De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen;

  • De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers;

  • Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback;

  • Stagevergoeding van € 650,- bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime

  • En nooit meer een ‘bad hair day’ dankzij de personeelskortingen op de gehele KEUNE collectie!

We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt.


KEUNE

Wij zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap het hart van alles is wat we doen. Ons verhaal begon in 1922 in Amsterdam. Vandaag, meer dan 100 jaar later, is Keune een van de snelstgroeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden Keune-producten wereldwijd ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en gedistribueerd naar meer dan 90 landen. Met een sterke focus op duurzaamheid en diervriendelijke praktijken, zijn we B-Corp-gecertificeerd en blijven we uitbreiden door jaarlijks een nieuwe locatie te openen. Onder leiding van Philip Berlijn richten wij ons op het bouwen van een sterk merk, het bevorderen van samenwerking, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter in alles wat we doen.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)
jobs.description:
Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)

Assen | 38 uur | Schaal 10

Het mooie van werken bij Univé

Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening? Ben jij een ervaren businessanalist die complexe processen doorgrondt, inhoudelijk richting geeft en graag zelf met beide benen in de praktijk staat?

Binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies werken we aan de migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics. Een uitdagende verandering waarbij niet alleen technologie, maar vooral onze bedrijfsprocessen en de dienstverlening aan onze leden centraal staan.

Als Senior Business Analist krijg jij de ruimte om deze verandering inhoudelijk vorm te geven. Je voert zelfstandig complexe analyses uit, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat businessbehoeften worden vertaald naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren businessanalist die overzicht houdt in complexe verandertrajecten. Je begrijpt hoe bedrijfsprocessen, informatievoorziening en IT-systemen samenhangen en weet deze kennis te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.

Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, maar vindt het minstens zo belangrijk om collega's verder te helpen.

Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe business- en procesanalyses binnen een IT-omgeving.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met zowel Synergy als Microsoft Dynamics.

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen naar functionele requirements.

  • Het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig uit te werken en anderen daarin mee te nemen.

  • Ervaring met het inhoudelijk begeleiden en coachen van collega-analisten.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van business en IT.

  • Kennis van Agile/Scrum en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams.

Ervaring met systeemmigraties, juridische dienstverlening of de verzekeringsbranche is een pré.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Business Analist werk je binnen het Rechtshulp Synergy-team aan de vernieuwing van het applicatielandschap voor onze juridische dienstverlening.

De migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics vormt een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw werkzaamheden.

Je brengt bestaande processen en informatievoorziening in kaart, onderzoekt welke verbeteringen mogelijk zijn en vertaalt deze naar heldere requirements voor de nieuwe omgeving.

Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de techniek. Je begrijpt welke impact veranderingen hebben op medewerkers, processen en uiteindelijk onze leden.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

  • Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van complexe business- en procesanalyses.

  • Het analyseren van bestaande Synergy-processen en het vertalen hiervan naar de gewenste inrichting binnen Dynamics.

  • Het ophalen, uitwerken en valideren van businessrequirements, user stories en acceptatiecriteria.

  • Het inzichtelijk maken van afhankelijkheden tussen processen, applicaties en andere IT-teams.

  • Het adviseren van de Product Owner en businessstakeholders over oplossingsrichtingen en verbeterkansen.

  • Het inhoudelijk begeleiden van andere businessanalisten en bewaken van de kwaliteit van analyses.

  • Het ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding en acceptatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten.

  • Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en de verdere professionalisering van businessanalyse.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Binnen de eerste zes maanden heb je de belangrijkste Rechtshulp-processen geanalyseerd en vertaald naar bruikbare requirements voor Dynamics.

Daarnaast heb je inhoudelijk richting gegeven aan de migratie en een zichtbare bijdrage geleverd aan de kwaliteit en zelfstandigheid van de andere analisten.

Je team

Je komt terecht in het Rechtshulp Synergy-team binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies.

Het team maakt onderdeel uit van IT Distributie, waar we nauw samenwerken met onze businesscollega's om de dienstverlening van Univé continu te verbeteren.

Je werkt in een team waarin medewerkers veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgen. We verwachten dat je zelfstandig kunt werken, initiatief toont en actief de samenwerking opzoekt.

Als senior krijg je een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol, zonder dat je formeel leidinggevende bent.

Je bent iemand bij wie collega's terechtkunnen voor complexe vraagstukken, maar die ook zelf graag de inhoud induikt.

Je standplaats is Assen.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Univé krijg je een uitdagende functie waarin je direct bijdraagt aan de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening.

Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je vakinhoudelijke kennis in te zetten en collega's verder te helpen.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10.

Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar, op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.

Daarnaast bieden we onder andere:

  • Een variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris.

  • Een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd.

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek.

  • Een goede studiekostenregeling en mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Een goede pensioenvoorziening.

  • Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.

  • Korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatie zonder winstoogmerk. We helpen onze leden risico's te voorkomen, gevolgen te beperken en problemen op te lossen.

Binnen Juridisch Advies ondersteunen we leden bij juridische vragen en problemen. Goede digitale ondersteuning helpt onze collega's om deze dienstverlening persoonlijk, toegankelijk en efficiënt te houden.

IT Distributie speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. We ontwikkelen en verbeteren de IT-oplossingen waarmee onze collega's hun werk kunnen doen en onze leden goed geholpen worden.

Daarbij geloven we in eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de ruimte om zelf verbeteringen aan te dragen.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij jouw ervaring met Synergy en Microsoft Dynamics inzetten om onze juridische dienstverlening toekomstbestendig te maken?

En krijg je energie van een rol waarin je complexe analyses combineert met het begeleiden van collega's?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
jobs.description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange (schaal 10) tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar (op basis van een 38-urige werkweek inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning).

 
De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:
•    je krijgt een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;
•    13e maand;
•    variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;
•    arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;
•    26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;
•    goede studiekostenregeling;
•    prima pensioenvoorziening;
•    reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;
•    en natuurlijk: korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.


Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients.

En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision.
