  • Assurer la continuité entre avant-vente et déploiement : collaborer avec les équipes Sales, Produit, Customer Success et Professional Services pour cadrer les besoins et garantir une transmission technique structurée après signature.

  • Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français et l'anglais (niveau C2) pour évoluer dans un environnement international.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un rôle stratégique : intervenir directement sur les opportunités à fort potentiel et contribuer à la croissance de Dastra.

  • Un environnement stimulant : évoluer à l'intersection du SaaS, de la protection des données, de la cybersécurité et de l'intelligence artificielle.

  • Une fonction en construction : rejoindre une organisation avant-vente en cours de structuration, avec l'opportunité de contribuer à son développement.

Alors, rencontrons-nous !

jobs.title: Senior Partnership Manager Payments
jobs.description:
Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.
Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development.
Kennis: Van card schemes, issuing, acquiring en de werking van het internationale betalingsverkeer.
Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau.
Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink!

Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes.

Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay.

Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken.

Intern werk je nauw samen met onder andere Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations en IT. Daarnaast vorm je samen met collega’s die zich meer richten op ontwikkeling en data een sterk team: jij richt je primair op de externe relaties en strategische partnerships.

Waar ga je dagelijks mee aan de slag:

  • Je bouwt en onderhoudt strategische relaties met Visa, Mastercard, Nederlandse banken, issuers en andere relevante partijen binnen payments.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor externe stakeholders en vertegenwoordigt Translink in strategische en inhoudelijke gesprekken.

  • Je ontwikkelt een duidelijke partnershipstrategie en meerjarige agenda voor de samenwerking met card schemes en banken.

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer, scheme rules en marktstandaarden en vertaalt deze naar impact en concrete acties voor Translink.

  • Je voert inhoudelijke en commerciële onderhandelingen over voorwaarden, kosten, dienstverlening en gezamenlijke verbeterinitiatieven.

  • Je verbindt externe marktontwikkelingen met interne technische, financiële en datagedreven inzichten.

  • Je adviseert management en directie over kansen, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en ontwikkelingen binnen het paymentecosysteem.

  • Je zorgt voor afstemming tussen Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT en externe partners bij complexe trajecten rondom payments en scheme compliance.

  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering en mogelijke organisatorische ontwikkeling van de paymentactiviteiten binnen Translink.


WIE ZOEKEN WE?

We zoeken een ervaren paymentprofessional die zijn of haar sporen in de sector heeft verdiend. Je begrijpt hoe banken, issuers, acquirers en card schemes met elkaar samenwerken en weet wat er nodig is om binnen dat complexe speelveld duurzame partnerships op te bouwen.

Je voelt je comfortabel aan tafel met senior stakeholders en bestuurders. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen helder uitleggen en weet de vertaalslag te maken tussen de buitenwereld en de interne organisatie. Tegelijkertijd ben je pragmatisch. Je bouwt niet alleen relaties, maar zorgt ook dat afspraken daadwerkelijk leiden tot resultaat.

Voor een ervaren professional biedt deze rol bovendien iets bijzonders: je werkt aan een maatschappelijk relevant betalingssysteem dat dagelijks door miljoenen reizigers wordt gebruikt.

WAT ZIT ERIN JOUW TAS?

DAS IST DER JOB

Location: Deutschland (Remote möglich)

Wir sind everdrop – eine schnell wachsende D2C Brand mit der Mission, die Welt der Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte nachhaltig zu verändern. Bei uns ist Influencer Marketing kein „Add-on“, sondern einer unserer wichtigsten Wachstumstreiber. Du entscheidest gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lead, wo wir investieren, was wir skalieren und was wir stoppen. Dabei nutzt du deine Creator-Beziehungen, Daten und KI, um neue Standards für unser Team zu setzen.


Als (Senior) Influencer Marketing Manager (m/w/d) bei everdrop werden das deine Hauptaufgaben sein:

  • Budget- & Portfolio-Ownership: Du verantwortest den Großteil unseres monatlichen Kooperationsbudgets im sechsstelligen Bereich eigenständig. Du steuerst ein hochvolumiges Portfolio aus Always-on-Creatorn, Performance-Partnern und Top-Creatorn und allokierst Budgets nach CAC, NC ROAS und Skalierungspotenzial. Du bist bereit, Budgets konsequent umzuschichten, wenn die Zahlen es verlangen.

  • Datenanalyse auf Expertenniveau: Du analysierst die Performance über den gesamten Funnel, von CPM und CTR über CVR und AOV bis zu CAC, NC ROAS und LTV. Du baust Dashboards und Forecasts selbst und kannst jederzeit belegen, warum eine Kooperation performt hat oder nicht. Deine Analysen sind die Grundlage für Budgetentscheidungen im Management.

  • Creator-Beziehungen & Verhandlung: Du bringst ein belastbares Netzwerk aus Creatorn und Management-Agenturen mit und baust es weiter aus. Du führst anspruchsvolle Vertrags- und Rahmenverhandlungen mit Top-Creatorn und Agenturen und entwickelst Vergütungsmodelle für nachhaltig hohen NC ROAS und langfristige Partnerschaften.

  • Kreatives Testing mit System: Du denkst in Hypothesen und isolierst Variablen sauber. Du planst Testing-Roadmaps für Produkte, Hooks, Formate und Angles, wertest sie statistisch belastbar aus und überführst die Learnings in Briefings, Bundles und Landingpages.

  • KI als Hebel und neuer Standard: Du setzt KI dort ein, wo sie Qualität und Geschwindigkeit steigert, zum Beispiel bei Creator-Scouting und -Scoring, Performance-Auswertung, Briefing-Erstellung oder Content-Analyse. Du entwickelst daraus Workflows und Best Practices, die das ganze Team nutzt, und hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse kritisch.

  • Konzeption, Bundles & Verkaufspsychologie: Du übersetzt Daten in messerscharfe, kreative Creator-Briefings, konzipierst unwiderstehliche Produkt-Bundles und gestaltest Landingpages mit, gezielt mit verkaufspsychologischen Triggern für maximale Conversion.

  • Schnittstelle zum Performance-Team: Du bist der verlängerte Arm von Paid Media. Du erkennst, welcher Creator-Content als Ad auf Meta oder TikTok performt, sicherst die nötigen Nutzungsrechte und lieferst dem Team laufend frisches Creative-Futter.

  • Channel-Expansion: Du bringst neue Plattformen und Formate in den Mix und baust sie datenbasiert auf. Gerade Social Commerce wie TikTok Shop (Affiliate-Programm, Live-Shopping) ist für uns ein spannendes Feld.

  • Sparring & Standards: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Management und Kolleg:innen, coachst bei Bedarf Junior-Kolleg:innen und hilfst, Prozesse, Benchmarks und Reportings im Team zu professionalisieren.


DAS BIST DU

Du hast Lust in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das sich für einen nachhaltigeren Lifestyle einsetzt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung von Tag 1, gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen und dynamischen Startup-Umfeld wohl? Wir glauben, das könnte ein gutes Match sein!

Bei everdrop arbeiten Menschen mit Growth Mindset, die Lust darauf haben, immer wieder Neues zu lernen. Wenn du gerne eigene Ideen einbringst, Lust hast, Dinge von Beginn an mitzugestalten und die folgenden Skills und Erfahrungen mitbringst, könnte das der Anfang einer wunderbaren Love Story sein.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Budget-Verantwortung: Du hast bereits einen Großteil eines monatlichen Creator-Spends im sechsstelligen Bereich eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und kannst nachweisen, welchen Impact deine Entscheidungen hatten.

  • KI-Kompetenz: Du hast KI bereits praktisch im Marketing eingesetzt, etwa für Analyse, Automatisierung oder Content-Prozesse, und kannst Beispiele nennen, wie du damit Ergebnisse verbessert oder Zeit gespart hast.

  • Analytische Exzellenz: CAC, NC ROAS, CVR, CPM und LTV sind dein Alltag. Du kannst komplexe Performance-Daten über den gesamten Funnel hinweg eigenständig auswerten, Zusammenhänge erkennen, bevor andere sie sehen, und daraus klare Budgetentscheidungen ableiten. Du hinterfragst Zahlen kritisch, trennst Korrelation von Kausalität und stellst deine Erkenntnisse so dar, dass auch das Management sofort handeln kann.

  • Netzwerk: Du bringst bestehende Beziehungen zu Creatorn und Agenturen im DACH-Raum und idealerweise darüber hinaus mit, sodass wir schnell Zugang zu starken Partner:innen bekommen.

  • Verhandlungsgeschick: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung mit komplexen Verträgen und Rahmenvereinbarungen mit Top-Creatorn und Management-Agenturen.

  • A/B-Testing-Mindset: Du isolierst Variablen, denkst in Hypothesen und leitest daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Konsumentenverständnis: Du kennst Direct-Response-Prinzipien und weißt, welche psychologischen Trigger Conversions auslösen, im Storytelling der Creator ebenso wie auf der Landingpage.

  • Ownership: Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit Durchschlagskraft, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine KPIs und behältst auch bei hoher Kampagnendichte den Überblick.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (mind. C1) und sichere Englischkenntnisse. Französisch, Italienisch und Polnisch sind ein Plus.

  • Plus: Erfahrung mit TikTok Shop (Affiliate, Live-Shopping, GMV-Tracking).

DAS IST EVERDROP


Unsere Mission 💚🌱🌎

Wir wollen die Welt verändern – gemeinsam mit dir! Die Alltagsprodukte von everdrop helfen den Menschen, ganz einfach ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck im Haushalt zu reduzieren. Im Jahr 2020 sind wir mit unseren Reiniger-Tabs gestartet. Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart. Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp. Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.

Unsere Benefits 🍲💪🏡

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice Möglichkeiten

  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub (plus 24.12. und 31.12. frei)

  • zusätzlich 2 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr für eigene umwelt- oder gemeinnützige Projekte ("Green & Social Impact Days”)

  • JobRad-Leasing für dein neues Traumradl

  • kostenloses veganes Mittagessen einmal pro Woche und Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine

  • Familien- und Freunde-Rabattcodes für everdrop und andere Startups for Tomorrow-Unternehmen

  • Mitgliedschaft und Discounts über FutureBens & Corporate Benefits

    Darüber hinaus erwarten dich ein wunderschönes, offenes Büro in der Nähe der Isar, ein Macbook solange du bei everdrop arbeitest, regelmäßige Team-Events, ein starker Teamgeist und ganz viele Office-Hunde die sich schon darauf freuen, dich kennenzulernen!


Unsere Werte 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍

Unser Commitment, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen, ist mit JEDI-Prinzipien verbunden. JEDI steht für Gerechtigkeit, Chancengerechtigkeit, Vielfalt und Inklusion (= Justice, Equity, Diversity, Inclusion). Wir verstehen diese Prinzipien als Grundlage unseres alltäglichen Handelns – sowohl intern beim Recruiting und innerhalb unserer Arbeitsabläufe, als auch gegenüber unseren Kund*innen und der Gesellschaft. Wir verpflichten uns dazu, daran zu arbeiten, systemische Barrieren abzubauen und eine Kultur zu fördern, in der jede Stimme gehört wird. Dies setzen wir durch konkrete Maßnahmen um:

Im Arbeitsalltag orientieren wir uns an unseren vier “Core Values”. Sie geben ganz klar vor, wie wir als Individuen und im Team miteinander arbeiten wollen:

#1 WE ARE AMBITIOUS
#2 WE TAKE OWNERSHIP

#4 WE ARE AWARE

Wir behandeln jeden Menschen gleich, unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, Aussehen, Sprache, Kultur, Nationalität, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung oder körperlicher Einschränkung.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will…

  • Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
  • Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
  • Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
  • Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function
  • Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants
  • Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight
  • Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences
  • Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed
  • Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities
  • Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network
  • Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network
  • Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota
  • Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework
  • Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Our humble expectations

  • Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship
  • Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments
  • A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences
  • Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation
  • A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other
  • Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams
  • Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership
  • A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
  • Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
  • Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities
  • Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements
  • A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams
  • Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

ToysReloved ist der einfachste Second-Hand-Service für Spielzeug: Eltern geben Spielsachen, aus denen ihre Kinder herausgewachsen sind, mit einem Klick weiter und tun dabei etwas Gutes. Wir sind ein dynamisches Berliner Start-up und bringen die Kreislaufwirtschaft in die Spielzeugbranche.

Jetzt suchen wir dich, um ToysReloved als Love Brand für Familien aufzubauen. Du bringst kreative Ideen ein, setzt sie gemeinsam mit dem Gründungsteam um und begeisterst Menschen für unsere Mission.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Brand & Community: Du entwickelst Ideen für unsere Marke und baust eine Community auf, die uns kennt, mag und weiterempfiehlt.

  • Content & Social: Du erzählst unsere Geschichte auf Instagram, TikTok und weiteren Kanälen, entwickelst neue Formate, produzierst Inhalte und stehst auch selbst vor der Kamera.

  • Go-to-Market & Growth: Du planst, startest und testest mit uns Kampagnen, Creator-Kooperationen und Aktionen, um neue Familien für uns zu gewinnen.

  • Customer Care: Du betreust täglich unseren Kundenchat, beantwortest Fragen und bist damit am nächsten dran an dem, was Familien bewegt. Aus ihrem Feedback machst du Ideen für Content und ein besseres Kundenerlebnis.

  • CRM & Kommunikation: Du hältst den Kontakt zu unserer Community, etwa über Newsletter, Geschichten und relevante Impulse für unsere Kund:innen.

  • Reichweite & Partnerschaften: Du findest Themen, Geschichten und Kooperationen, die uns auch über Social Media hinaus sichtbar machen, etwa über Suche, Medien oder Events.

  • Projekte & KI: Du bringst eigene Initiativen von der Idee bis zur Auswertung voran und nutzt KI-Tools kreativ, um Inhalte und Prozesse besser zu machen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist eingeschrieben, arbeitest gern selbstständig und bist gern bei uns im Berliner Office.

  • Du willst etwas aufbauen, denkst unternehmerisch und wartest nicht auf fertige Briefings.

  • Du verstehst Social Media, erkennst Trends und hast Spaß daran, selbst Content zu produzieren.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, denkst aus Kundensicht und fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl.

  • Du probierst KI-Tools aus und hast Ideen, wie sie kreative Arbeit und Abläufe verbessern können.

  • Du kommunizierst sorgfältig und setzt Ideen auch im Tagesgeschäft zuverlässig um.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Plus: Erste Erfahrungen mit Instagram, TikTok, Canva, Klaviyo und generativer KI.

  • Bonus: Ein Herz für Nachhaltigkeit, Familien und Spielzeug.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins, Raum zum Experimentieren und Platz für deine eigenen Ideen.

  • Eine kreative Rolle zwischen Brand, Community, Content und Growth statt starrer Aufgabenlisten.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründungsteam in einem wachsenden Start-up.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote-Arbeit, die zu deinem Studium passen.

  • Ein heller Arbeitsplatz in einem historischen Gebäude am Ostkreuz, mit gutem Bio-Kaffee.

  • Arbeit mit Sinn: Du hilfst, Spielzeug ein zweites Leben zu schenken.

Lust, mit uns die Spielzeugbranche zu verändern? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

jobs.title: Social Media & External Communication Manager
jobs.description:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will own how Agent F and its founder show up in the world: on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube, on the blog and in the newsletter, in the press, on podcasts and stages, and in the ecosystem around us. You will create and distribute content every day, run the founder’s profiles, manage relationships with journalists and media makers, and keep the network warm.

The bar is concrete. At least one to two good pieces of content go out every day. The audience grows, and it is the right audience: finance and operations leaders, founders and the people around them. Inbound interest arrives that can be traced back to something you published. You will have the founder’s time, the customers’ stories and the product’s progress as raw material; turning that into a consistent, credible voice is your job.

You will work closely with the Online Marketing Manager, who owns paid channels and the funnel. You own the organic, owned and earned side: the brand, the voice, the content and the relationships.

What you will build and own

  • The founder’s presence. Positioning, editorial calendar, drafting and publishing, replies and community. The founder reviews; you run it.

  • The company’s channels. LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, blog, newsletter. One voice, one visual identity, a cadence that does not slip.

  • Daily content. Posts, short videos, articles, visuals. Take one idea and make it work across formats and channels.

  • External communication. Press relations, podcasts, events and speaking, launches and announcements, partner communication; working with PR agencies where engaged.

  • The network. Journalists, podcasters, communities and ecosystem contacts, kept on a live list and in a warm relationship.

  • Brand assets. Guidelines, templates and tone of voice, kept current and actually used.

For example, a customer goes live and their CFO says something memorable in the final call. You would turn it into a founder post the same day, a short video for the company channel the next, a line in the newsletter and a pitch to a journalist who covers finance software, and track what came back from each.

What you bring

You have three or more years in content, social media or communications for a B2B company or a founder brand, with proof of an audience you built and content you shipped at pace. You write clearly in German and English, edit short video and work with design tools and AI tools every day.

You understand finance, software or the Mittelstand well enough to write for a demanding audience without embarrassing yourself or us. You can show us a channel you grew, a piece that worked and one that did not, and a press placement you earned. You are fast, consistent and allergic to empty posts, and you are comfortable approaching journalists and strangers.

Core experience

  • Daily content production across LinkedIn and at least one video platform, with measurable audience growth.

  • Writing in German and English for a professional audience; editing short video; working with design and AI tools.

  • Running a founder’s or an executive’s public profile.

  • Press and media relations: pitching, placing, maintaining relationships.

  • Community and network management in a B2B context.

  • Reading analytics and adjusting content to what works.

Useful additional experience

Experience in fintech, software or Mittelstand communications; newsletter growth; event and speaking logistics; working with PR agencies; podcast production.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would set the editorial rhythm for the founder and the company, get daily publishing running, refresh the channels and the brand assets, and place the first press and podcast appearances around our announcements.

We would look for the daily cadence holding, audience growing in the right segments, engagement rising and the first inbound conversations that trace back to content.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a brand that is consistent and a voice that is credible. Content ships daily, including during launches and travel. Press and public reactions are monitored and answered the same day.

When an announcement, a launch or a public issue needs attention outside normal hours, you are there, you keep the founder informed and you handle it with judgement.

How you will work

You report to the CEO and work closely with the founder on their presence, with the Online Marketing Manager on content and amplification, and with sales on customer stories. You will use AI tools for drafting, editing and analysis and remain responsible for the voice and the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. German and English are required.

Start a conversation

Share a channel you grew and three pieces of content you are proud of (at least one of them for a B2B audience). Tell us what worked, what did not and what you would publish for Agent F in your first week.

Ad spend per channel, the funnels behind it, the landing pages, the email sequences, the tracking: all of it is yours to build, measure and improve. You will produce funnel content yourself, brief agencies and freelancers for the rest, and run experiments until the numbers move.

The idea is simple and unusual for our category: sell business software the way consumer products are sold online. Our buyers are finance and operations leaders at corporate subsidiaries and Mittelstand companies, and they search, click, compare and book like everyone else. You will find the channels, messages and paths that bring them to a demo or a sign-up at a cost that works, and you will keep looking for the next growth hack when the last one stops working.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain. For you, that means pipeline and live ARR that trace back to marketing.

What you will build and own

  • Paid acquisition. Budget allocation across channels, campaign setup and optimisation, creative testing. Cut what does not convert; scale what does.

  • Funnels and conversion. Landing pages, sign-up and demo-booking flows, email nurture. Continuous experimentation, measured against one dashboard. Work with the Product Design Engineer on the product’s self-serve path.

  • Search and discoverability. Organic and AI-search visibility: the content and pages that bring qualified traffic, with the technical basics handled with engineering.

  • Content for the funnel. Ads, landing copy, lead magnets and sequences produced in-house; agencies and freelancers briefed and managed for the rest.

  • Measurement. Attribution from spend to live ARR; cost per lead, cost per qualified opportunity, cost per signed and per live euro of ARR. Weekly reporting to sales and leadership.

  • Lead hand-over. Define what a qualified lead is together with the Head of Sales, hand it over cleanly and close the loop on what became pipeline.

For example, a paid campaign brings traffic but few demo bookings. You would look at the landing page, the audience and the offer, run two or three variants, move the budget to what converts, and report the change in cost per qualified opportunity the following week.

What you bring

You have four or more years in performance or growth marketing for B2B software, with full ownership of a budget and a conversion target. You have run paid channels, built landing pages and funnels, and you can show the numbers.

You can explain an experiment that worked and one that did not, what you measured and what you changed. You are comfortable with analytics tools, spreadsheets and tracking, and you use AI tools for content and analysis every day. You do not need to be loud; you need to be curious, rigorous and fast.

Core experience

  • Paid acquisition across search, social and display for B2B software, with owned budgets.

  • Landing pages, funnels and conversion optimisation, including A/B testing.

  • Search and AI-search visibility: content, structure, technical basics.

  • Email marketing and lead nurturing.

  • Analytics, tracking and attribution; working comfortably in spreadsheets and dashboards.

  • Producing funnel content in German and English with AI tools; briefing agencies and freelancers.

Useful additional experience

Marketing for ERP, accounting or finance software; product-led growth and self-serve funnels; marketing automation and CRM integration; programmatic or data-driven content.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would set up the measurement, take over the existing channels and pages, and run the first experiments on the highest-volume path from ad to demo. You would agree the definition of a qualified lead with sales and start reporting weekly.

We would look for a falling cost per qualified opportunity, more qualified traffic, a funnel that converts better each month and pipeline that sales can confirm.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in numbers that are correct and campaigns that run clean. Campaigns and funnels are monitored daily; broken tracking, failing pages or runaway spend are fixed the same day.

You keep sales informed about what is coming into the funnel and close the loop on what happened to it. When a launch or a campaign needs attention outside normal hours, you are there.

How you will work

You report to the CEO and work closely with the Head of Sales on lead quality, with the Social Media & External Communication Manager on content and amplification, and with the Product Design Engineer on the product’s self-serve path. You will use AI tools for content, analysis and reporting and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. German and English are required.

You will sell. Our buyers are CEOs, CFOs and heads of finance at corporate subsidiaries and Mittelstand companies: an experienced audience that values clarity, numbers and reliability over charm. You will open those conversations, run them to signature and stay with the account until it is live, paying and expanding. Key accounts are a team effort: the CEO is in the room with you, and the whole company pulls through to go-live.

You will also build the sales organisation. Two Growth & Sales Managers work with you from day one; more will follow. You are their functional lead: you review their pipeline, join their calls, coach them on deals and give them a playbook that works. The foundation you lay is what lets the team scale without losing its direction.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain.

What you will build and own

  • The revenue chain. Define each stage from first conversation to expansion, give it an owner, a conversion rate and a cycle time, and report the whole chain weekly in one view.

  • Your own accounts. Carry a quota. Lead enterprise and corporate accounts together with the CEO; own mid-market deals outright. Stay with every account through go-live and into expansion.

  • The sales playbook. ICP definitions, qualification criteria, demo script, proposal and pricing standards, go-live hand-over, expansion motion. Not a document: the operating system of the sales team.

  • The team. Weekly pipeline and deal reviews, joint customer meetings, ramp plans for new team members. Measure output, coach on it, raise the bar with every hire.

  • Signed to live. Work with the Forward Deployed Engineers so that every signed customer goes live inside the onboarding SLA. No deal is done until the customer is live and paying.

  • Live to expansion. Own the expansion motion: additional modules, seats, usage, further entities. Own net revenue retention.

  • Business development. Partnerships, resellers and implementation partners where they produce live ARR faster than direct sales.

For example, a corporate subsidiary with three entities signs for one of them. You would run the go-live with the Forward Deployed Engineer, make sure the first entity is live and reconciled inside the SLA, and have the expansion to the other two entities agreed before the first invoice is paid.

What you bring

You have ten or more years in B2B software sales, with personal closes at C-level and a track record that includes a phase of extreme growth, for example from a handful of customers to a team of twenty or more, or from near zero to tens of millions in revenue. You have built or materially shaped a playbook that other people then ran successfully.

You can walk us through a deal you closed with an experienced buyer, what the buyer needed to see, how you got to signature, and what happened after. You can also show us a team member who became better because of you.

Core experience

  • Full-cycle B2B software sales to finance, operations or executive buyers, with personal quota attainment.

  • Selling to German-speaking corporate and Mittelstand buyers; fluent German and English.

  • Building a playbook, a pipeline process and a forecast that a team then runs.

  • Coaching and developing sales people; running pipeline and deal reviews.

  • Expansion and retention of existing customers; net revenue retention as an owned number.

  • CRM discipline: stages, next steps, forecast accuracy as a matter of course.

  • Daily use of AI tools for research, preparation and follow-up.

Useful additional experience

ERP, accounting or financial operations software; channel and partner sales; implementation-heavy products where go-live is part of the sale; experience alongside a technical implementation team.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take over the active pipeline, close your first deals with the CEO and alone, and write down the playbook as you go. You would set up the weekly revenue view, run the first pipeline reviews with the Growth & Sales Managers and agree the signed-to-live hand-over with the Forward Deployed Engineers.

We would look for closed deals, customers going live inside the SLA, a forecast that holds, and team members whose numbers are improving. The exact priorities will follow the pipeline you find.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in customers who are live, paying and growing. When a signed customer’s go-live is at risk, a live customer threatens to churn or a key deal needs a decision now, you respond the same day, take the lead with the customer and stay on it until it is resolved or explicitly handed over.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, travel to a customer and stay engaged when a go-live, a renewal or a financial deadline is at risk. You keep people informed and see the issue through. Afterwards, you improve the playbook so the same situation becomes less likely.

How you will work

This is a senior role in a small team. You report to the CEO and are the functional lead of the Growth & Sales Managers; line management for everyone stays with the CEO. You will work closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on go-live and with marketing on top of funnel. You will use AI tools for research, preparation and follow-up and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Travel to customers across the DACH region is part of the role. Fluent German is required.

You will be the technical counterpart for the customer’s finance, IT and operations teams, the person who knows what was promised and what is possible, and the one who brings back to engineering (as clear, prioritised requirements) whatever cannot be solved on site. On key accounts the CEO is in the room and the whole team pulls through together.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain. For you, that means time to live and the ARR of the accounts you bring live.

What you will build and own

  • Implementation projects. Own scope, plan and delivery from kick-off to verified go-live for your accounts: stakeholders, timeline, risks, decisions.

  • Migration and integration. Map the customer’s data, run the imports, reconcile totals against the source and connect Agent F to the systems the customer keeps. Verify the result with the customer before go-live.

  • Configuration and extension. Workflows, rules, automations and custom logic on the platform, set up for the customer’s way of working.

  • Customer-facing technical lead. Run the technical workstreams with the customer’s finance, IT and operations teams; document decisions and keep everyone informed.

  • Product feedback. Turn what customers need into specified, prioritised requirements for engineering; validate delivered features with the customer.

  • Expansion readiness. Identify and prepare the next step in each account (the next entity, module or process) together with the account owner.

  • FDE economics. Track the hours you deliver per account against what was sold and keep delivery inside the agreed effort.

For example, a corporate subsidiary signs with a go-live date tied to its next month-end. You would scope the migration, map and import the history, reconcile it with the customer’s controller, configure the approval workflows, connect the bank feed, and run the first close with them (inside the SLA) while logging the two product gaps you found as clear requirements for engineering.

What you bring

You have five or more years in technical implementation, solutions consulting or IT project management for business software (ERP, accounting, finance or operations systems) with real customer projects behind you. You are hands-on with data, mappings, configuration and integrations and comfortable reconciling a migration yourself. You do not need to be a software engineer.

You can walk us through an implementation you ran: what the customer needed, what went wrong, how you got to go-live and what you would do differently. You are calm with customers, precise with engineers and stubborn about go-live.

Core experience

  • Implementation or technical project management of ERP, accounting, finance or operations software with corporate or Mittelstand customers.

  • Data migration: mapping, import, reconciliation against the source, validation with the customer.

  • Configuration of business software: workflows, rules, permissions, integrations.

  • Working with finance teams: understanding the chart of accounts, closing processes and what has to reconcile.

  • Running projects with multiple stakeholders: plan, risks, decisions, communication.

  • Writing clear requirements for engineers and validating what they deliver.

  • German and English; daily use of AI tools in project and data work.

Useful additional experience

Experience with SQL, scripting or low-code tools; integrations with banking, payroll or procurement systems; month-end and year-end close from the inside; consulting or customer-success experience with SaaS products.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take over an onboarding in progress, bring it live inside the SLA and document the path. You would then own your next accounts from kick-off, build the migration and configuration playbook with engineering and hand the first clear requirements into the roadmap.

We would look for customers live on time and reconciled, fewer issues after go-live, requirements that ship, and hours delivered inside what was sold.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in customers who are live and whose numbers reconcile. When a go-live blocker, a failed migration or a month-end issue puts a customer deadline at risk, you take ownership, contain the impact, work with engineering on the fix and verify the result with the customer before treating it as resolved.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an onboarding commitment or a financial deadline is at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed coverage. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover.

How you will work

This is a founding role in a small team. You report to the CEO and work daily with the Growth & Sales Managers who own the accounts, with the Head of Sales on what was sold, and with the engineering team on what the product can do. You will use AI tools in project, data and documentation work and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Travel to customer sites is part of the role. German is required.

Start a conversation

Share an implementation you ran. Tell us what the customer needed, how you handled the migration and the configuration, what went wrong, how you got to go-live and what you learned. A short written case or a walkthrough is enough.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff & Operations
jobs.description:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will run the inside of Agent F. Projects get carried through end to end, the inbox and the follow-ups behind it get resolved, finance and administration simply work, and whatever can be automated internally gets automated, on our own technology wherever possible. The point is leverage: leadership stays on C-level sales, product, strategy and investors, and the company runs smoothly underneath.

This is an operating role with a lot of freedom. Some weeks the most important thing is a notary appointment, a filing deadline or a payment; other weeks it is a project that has stalled, a new hire who needs a proper first week, or a workflow that should never have needed a person in the first place. You decide what matters, you make it happen, and you make sure it does not come back.

You will also lay the foundation for what comes next. We expect to grow quickly. The processes, documentation and automations you build now are what let the company double without doubling its administration. Agent F is its own first customer: our finance operations should run on our product, and you will make sure they do.

What you will build and own

  • Project execution. Maintain the company project list. Every project has an owner, a next step and a date. Chase, unblock, close. Report weekly which projects are on track, at risk or done.

  • Inbox and follow-ups. Triage, prepare and resolve what lands with leadership. Track follow-ups across customers, investors, partners and providers so nothing stays open without an owner.

  • Finance operations. Monthly close inputs for the tax advisor, invoice flows, expense and card management, payroll inputs, cash reporting, VAT and filing deadlines. Automate these flows on our own stack first.

  • The second brain. Own the internal knowledge and workflow system and its AI agents. Every recurring task is automated or delegated before it gets a second owner.

  • Legal and admin operations. Contract templates and signatures, notary and registry processes, insurance, the compliance register, data-protection documentation. Work with external counsel; own the follow-through.

  • People operations. Assist in onboarding new hires, keep the hiring process running (scheduling, candidate communication, paperwork) and handle contracts and equity documentation.

  • Investor and board operations. Monthly updates, data room, KPI pack, meeting logistics; the numbers are ready on time.

For example, a new customer contract, a notary appointment for the GmbH and a VAT filing all land in the same week while the CEO is travelling. You would get the contract signed, the appointment prepared and the filing submitted, and then set up the workflow so that the next contract, appointment and filing need no one to chase them.

What you bring

You have five or more years in roles that combined operating responsibility with structure: startup operations, finance operations, consulting followed by an operating role, or a founder’s office in a scaling company. You have run a function end to end and can show processes that still work without you.

You can explain how you took a messy, recurring piece of work and made it disappear (through a process, a tool or an automation) and what it freed up. You are comfortable with numbers, contracts and tools, and you use AI tools to build automations as a matter of course.

Core experience

  • Operations or finance operations in a startup or scaling company, with end-to-end ownership of a function.

  • German administration and accounting: invoices, monthly close inputs, payroll inputs, VAT and filings, working with a tax advisor.

  • Project management across a company: owners, deadlines, status, escalation.

  • Building workflows and automations with modern tools and AI agents; documenting them so others can run them.

  • Working with external counsel, notaries, banks and providers; contracts and signatures.

  • Clear, short written communication in German and English.

Useful additional experience

Experience in a founder’s office or chief-of-staff role; investor reporting and data rooms; people operations and onboarding; experience with accounting or ERP software from the user side.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take over the project list and the inbox, get the monthly finance operations running on a fixed rhythm, and automate the first two or three recurring flows. You would onboard the next hires and set up the hiring process so that it runs without leadership attention.

We would look for projects that close on time, an inbox with no orphaned items, filings and numbers delivered on schedule, and a growing list of work that no longer needs a person.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a company that runs smoothly. When something in operations needs a same-day answer (a payment, a filing, a signature, an escalation that landed with leadership), you handle it or find the person who can, and you stay on it until it is done.

Availability during travel and fundraising phases is part of the role. You keep people informed, close loops and improve the process afterwards so that the same situation needs less attention next time.

How you will work

This is a senior founding role reporting to the CEO, with the freedom to decide week by week what the inside of the company needs most. You will work with every function (sales, engineering, marketing) and with our external advisors and providers. You will use AI tools and our own product to automate your work and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Fluent German is required.

Start a conversation

Tell us about a function you ran end to end and a piece of recurring work you made disappear. What did it look like before, what did you build, and what still runs without you today? A short written example is enough.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Manager Retail & Products ben je dé gesprekspartner voor bestuurders in de retail, FMCG, (maak)industrie, logistiek en groothandel die hun commerciële organisatie naar een hoger niveau willen tillen: meer groei uit dezelfde markt, de juiste prijs per klant, kanaal en moment, en een salesorganisatie die structureel wint. Daarnaast bouw je mee aan het Retail & Products-team zelf: je ontwikkelt onze Commercial Excellence-proposities, helpt collega’s groeien en bent een drijvende kracht achter onze verdere gezamenlijke groei.

Je komt te werken bij een Great Place to Work met zeer tevreden medewerkers en klanten (NPS > 65; ruim boven het marktgemiddelde). ·       Ondernemende instelling en drive om verandering en groei te realiseren – zowel bij onze klanten als binnen onze eigen organisatie.

 

Wat we jou bieden:

·       Een mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei van de organisatie.

·       Royale bonusregeling.

·       En nog veel meer, waar we je graag meer over vertellen.


Waarom IG&H?

IG&H helpt toonaangevende bedrijven in de sectoren Gezondheid, Retail & Products en Financial Services te transformeren. Samen met onze technologiepartners van wereldklasse helpen we onze klanten vooruit en blijven we relevant. Met inzichtelijk advies, mooie designs en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol op elkaar afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsprocessen en technologie. Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's in de verschillende teams, die verandering en uitdagingen oprecht omarmen, hebben we een unieke, zeer gedurfde en zorgzame cultuur gecreëerd. We trekken bijzondere mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten.

IG&H is er trots op een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een baan, ongeacht hun afkomst, religie, geslacht, genderexpressie, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit! Maar het allerbelangrijkste is dat we allemaal trots zijn op onze prestaties bij onze klanten en daarom zijn we niet voor niets een Great Place to Work.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager:in
jobs.description:
Über Valova

Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann.

Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben, während die meisten deutschen Kliniken bereits rote Zahlen schreiben.

Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden. Erst Deutschland, dann Europa.

Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up-Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist

Mit Valova kodieren Kliniken ihre Fälle schon heute deutlich schneller. Und das ist erst der Anfang: Wir bauen Valova Schritt für Schritt über die Kodierung hinaus aus, und jede Erweiterung muss im Klinikalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Du findest heraus, wo Kodierteams Zeit und Erlöse verlieren, entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes bauen, und bringst es mit unserem Engineeringteam live. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger Minuten pro Fall und in mehr Fällen, die Valova ohne Korrektur abrechnet.

Deine Rolle im Team

Du berichtest direkt an Malte, unseren Produkt Lead, und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Engineers zusammen. Fachlich arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Kodier- und Abrechnungsexpert:innen: Sie kennen die Regeln, Du machst daraus Produkt. In Klinikprojekten arbeitest Du Hand in Hand mit unserem Vertrieb und Customer Success und auf Klinikseite mit Medizincontrolling, Kodierfachkräften und Ärzt:innen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Einen Produktbereich verantworten: Du übernimmst einen eigenen Bereich unseres Produkts, von der ersten Anforderung bis zum Einsatz in der Klinik.

  • Vor Ort beobachten: Du bist regelmäßig in Kliniken, schaust Kodierteams und Medizincontrolling über die Schulter und findest heraus, wo Zeit und Erlöse verloren gehen.

  • Anforderungen schreiben: Du übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien und klärst offene Fragen, bevor sie die Entwicklung aufhalten.

  • Regeln ins Produkt bringen: Mit unseren Fachexpert:innen sorgst Du dafür, dass Kodier- und Abrechnungsregeln richtig im Produkt ankommen.

  • Unsere KI besser machen: Du arbeitest mit Engineering an Evaluationen und prüfst, ob die Vorschläge von Valova mit jedem Release besser werden.

  • Releases begleiten: Du testest neue Versionen und begleitest mit Customer Success den Start in neuen Kliniken.

  • Mit Daten arbeiten: Du verfolgst, wie Valova genutzt wird und wirkt, und leitest daraus ab, was wir als Nächstes bauen.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Medizinischer Hintergrund: Idealerweise ein Medizinstudium, eine Ausbildung in einem Gesundheitsfachberuf oder Erfahrung im Medizincontrolling. Du weißt, wie ein Fall durchs Krankenhaus läuft.

  • Erste Produkterfahrung: Ein bis zwei Jahre im Produktmanagement, in einem Health-Tech-Startup oder in der Beratung. Du hast schon einmal ein Feature oder Projekt von der Idee bis zum Ergebnis verantwortet.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Du musst nicht programmieren, kannst aber technische Dokumentation lesen und mit Engineers über Lösungen diskutieren.

  • Präzises Denken: Du hinterfragst gern Prozesse und beschreibst Regeln so genau, dass Software sie umsetzen kann.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist im Gespräch mit Ärzt:innen, Medizincontrolling und Technik gleichermaßen sicher.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist gern rund 20 bis 30 Prozent Deiner Zeit in Kliniken unterwegs.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch fließend auf C1-Niveau und gutes Englisch.

  • Ein Plus: Kenntnisse in Kodierung oder Abrechnung (z. B. DRG, OPS, GOÄ), Erfahrung mit KIS-Software (z. B. Orbis, SAP IS-H, i.s.h.med) oder Tools wie Jira und Figma sowie erste Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse (Excel, SQL) oder KI-Anwendungen.

Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ownership ab der ersten Woche. Du übernimmst echte Projekte mit klarem Ergebnis und deinem Namen darauf, keine Aufgabenliste, die sich jemand anderes ausgedacht hat.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

  • Lernen im Startup-Tempo. Du erlebst hier in einem Jahr mehr als anderswo in drei.

  • Ein Team, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort im WeWork am Odeonsplatz in München und im WeWork in Berlin-Mitte. Voll ausgestattete Büros mit Kaffee, Meetingräumen und Phone Booths bedeuten null Verwaltungsaufwand, und die zentrale Lage bedeutet kurze Wege, schnellen Zugang zu Kunden und Investoren und Mittagsoptionen an jeder Ecke.

  • Ein motiviertes Team. , mit Ärztinnen und Ärzten, Engineers und Operators, die sich hohe Ziele setzen und sich gegenseitig dabei unterstützen, sie zu erreichen.

  • Team-Events, die München und Berlin zusammenbringen, denn die Menschen, mit denen du baust, sollten auch die sein, mit denen du feierst.

  • Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, das deinen Impact widerspiegelt.

So sieht Erfolg aus

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Payments Team
jobs.description:
Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on!

Your role

Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger.

The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve.

We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day. We encourage responsible AI usage and provide tooling like Claude Code, Codex, Dust. 

You’ll work closely with the other product teams, alongside fellow Backend Engineers, Data, Design, an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager in a Scrum setup. This role suits an engineer who enjoys a complex domain, cares about getting the details right, and wants to grow by taking real ownership of business-critical systems.

Your overall responsibilities include

  • Designing, developing, testing and reviewing reusable, maintainable and scalable code

  • Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop;

  • Taking ownership from discovery to post-production;

  • Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis;

  • Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices


Who we are looking for

In order to be successful in this role, you bring a strong sense of ownership and a pragmatic, proactive mindset. You enjoy working in a collaborative scale-up environment where things can change quickly and where taking initiative matters.

Additionally, you tick the following boxes:

  • You have 3+ years of professional backend experience, with strong hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience.

  • You have previous experience in the payments domain.

  • You have experience working in agile teams within an international, multicultural environment.

  • You have experience building and operating microservices in production, using REST APIs, cloud platforms and relational databases.

  • You are familiar with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka.

  • You care about reliability, maintainability and the operational impact of the software you build.

  • You spot opportunities and problems and pick them up yourself instead of waiting for a ticket.

  • You use AI tooling as part of your engineering workflow, with sound engineering judgement.

  • You are fluent in English and have an affinity with Fastned’s mission.

Nice to have

  • Experience in e-mobility, energy, charging infrastructure or another operationally complex domain.

Join us in building a better future

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We focus on work-life balance, provide genuine work flexibility, and have family-friendly policies in place.

Electric mobility is new territory for you? Don’t worry!

As part of your onboarding, you will participate in a series of exciting workshops where you will learn everything about our industry and fast-charging infrastructure.

Our benefits package includes:

  • Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation.

  • Pension plan (fully covered by Fastned).

  • A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities.

  • In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered), which is also for private use.

  • 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you two mission days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you.

  • Going the extra mile for parents: We provide you with personalised coaching support before, during, and after parental leave, facilitated by Foundree.

  • Understanding women's health is beneficial for all of us, fostering empathy, improving communication, and creating a more inclusive workplace. That's why we teamed up with Flouria, providing you with quick access to a broad range of women's health professionals.

  • Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations.

  • Next to fun events year-round, we throw notorious Christmas parties and organise an amazing yearly trip abroad with all employees.

  • Other perks include flexible working hours, full travel compensation and the working gear of your choice.

Interested in making an impact?

We would love to have a conversation with you!

Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your motivation letter why you’re excited about joining Fastned.

Here’s the next steps of the hiring process:

  • Screening call with Recruiter

  • Codility assignment and technical interview with our Engineers

  • Culture-fit conversation with the team

  • Closing Coffee Chat with our Head of Engineering / Director of Product & Engineering


Then, it’s time to welcome you on board to Fastned!


Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique.

Innatera is a rapidly growing Dutch semiconductor company that develops ultra-efficient neuromorphic processors for AI at the edge. These microprocessors mimic the brain’s mechanisms for processing fast data streams from sensors, enabling complex turn-key sensor analytics functionalities, with 10,000x higher performance per watt than competing solutions. Innatera's technology serves as a critical enabler for next-generation use cases in the IoT, wearable, embedded, and automotive domains.

To support our rapid development roadmap, we’re looking for a Senior SDK Hardware Simulation Engineer to help drive the development of our simulation environment by enabling early application development and system validation before hardware is available. As a key member of our SDK team, you’ll be responsible for designing and building accurate, high-performance C++ hardware simulators that accurately reflect our neuromorphic architecture. This role is critical to how our software and hardware teams collaborate to test, validate, and iterate on next-gen chip designs.

We will trust you with:

  • Design and implement simulation models in modern C++ (C++17/20) to replicate the functions of neuromorphic processors, CPUs, memory systems, and other components in the full SoC;

  • Convert technical hardware specs into high-performance, verifiable software models;

  • Contribute to performance modeling: simulate power consumption, latency to identify performance bottlenecks;

  • Support early application development with accurate and configurable hardware simulation tools;

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (Digital Design, Firmware, SDK) to ensure models reflect the real hardware faithfully;

  • Take ownership of simulation infrastructure quality: write unit tests, review code, and continuously improve design and maintainability;

  • Collaborate on expanding our SDK feature set, ensuring the usability of the simulation for external developers.

  • Participate in team brainstorming and contribute to other SDK development tasks as needed.

What will you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field;

  • Strong C++ development skills (including C++17/20);

  • Proven track record of designing modular, maintainable, and testable software architecture;

  • Experience in transaction-level modeling of hardware components;

  • Solid understanding of digital hardware fundamentals (e.g., CPU, instruction sets, memory systems, DMA);

  • Familiarity with hardware/software co-design concepts;

  • Working knowledge of Python (e.g., for scripting, automation, or SDK integration);

  • Great communication skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with RTL simulations, waveforms, and understanding how hardware behaves at the signal level;

  • Exposure to bare-metal firmware development, including assembly language;

  • Familiarity with RISC-V or ARM computer architectures;

  • Knowledge of machine learning, edge AI, and SNN (Spiking Neural Networks).
